items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And I suppose he had never left Tyler before, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] No, he -- I just found out that he had left when he was quite young.

ctx.x: Well, he -- yes. He was gone for -- I think it was about -- yeah, about three or four years, I figured it was.
And I suppose he had never left Tyler before, huh?
No, he -- I just found out that he had left when he was quite young.
